simple.meaning: יֶהְדַי (Yehday) is a Hebrew word meaning “Jehdai , an Israelite.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: This word has limited occurrence data, so BibleIQ begins with the Hebrew word, its basic meaning, and the verse where it appears.

simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in יֶהְדַי (H3056) before moving outward to related references.

definitions.full: H3056. Yahday [ יַהְדַּי ] proper name, masculine one of the family of Caleb (according to Thes = ׳י יהדיה, leads compare Ol § 277 h, p. 621 ; but dubious) יַהְדָּ֑י 1Chr 2:47 (Baer; and elsewhere יֶהְדָּ֑י ). הֹדֹה see הוד . יֶהְדַּי יַהִדַּי, proper name, masculine see below הדה
definitions.rootNote: perhaps from a form corresponding to 3061 ; Judaistic;

occurrences.englishText: The sons of Jahdai: Regem, Jothan, Geshan, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.
